title: The Heretic's Bonfire
text: The Court's zealots are burning books in the square, whole libraries going up in a roaring pyre, pages curling like black leaves into the sky. The crowd cheers. A young novice beside you is weeping, and she slips a single torn page into your hands.

options.label: The wisest reads the novice's page.

outcomes.text: A lost rite of the Six, half burned, and still holy.
The zealots turn on you, faces lit orange.

options.label: Throw the page into the fire too.

outcomes.text: The zealots bless you, loudly. The novice does not look at you again.
